meta.title: One picture, two destinations
meta.about: SaveImage writes to the output folder. PreviewImage writes to the temp folder. Run it and look for both files.

notes.1: A solid picture, so no model is needed.
notes.2: Writes university/first_00001_.png, or the next free number, inside the output folder.
notes.3: Writes a throw-away file to the temp folder and shows it on the node.
